ai_disabled_hint: AI is turned off. Enable it in Settings → AI.
ai_fell_back: The AI returned no usable result ({reason}); the signal was produced by the analysis engine
ai_unavailable: AI unavailable; the analysis engine was used instead
analysis_absent: No AI analysis has been saved for this signal yet. Press “Re-run AI analysis” to generate one now.
analysis_empty: No written analysis stored for this signal.

auto.hint: The app generates signals on its own. Choose the source: the signals found by the scan above (re-checked often), the whole market (every exchange symbol is swept in rotation), or both. Strong signals found during a sweep join the focus list immediately.
auto.reason_bootstrap: First scan to build the selection list
auto.status_failed: The automatic scan failed; the next attempt will run on schedule.
auto.status_need_scan: Source is "signals found above" but the list is empty — run a scan first.
auto.title: Automatic signals

click_row_hint: Click a symbol to see full detail
confidence_note: Confidence expresses how well the analytical factors agree with each other. It is NOT a probability of profit.
forecast_note: The range is derived from measured volatility and is not a guarantee.
insufficient_data: Insufficient market data — no signal can be produced.
legend_text: Bold green: confidence 60+ • Green: 50–59 • Amber: 35–49 • Grey: below 35
no_action_on_wait: There is no action to take on a WAIT signal
not_financial_advice: This is technical analysis, not financial advice. You are responsible for your own trades.
paper_trade_failed: No position opened — the signal has no usable entry price
paper_trade_note: This is a paper trade. No real order is placed on the exchange.
pdf_failed: Could not create the PDF file.
rerun_saved: The new analysis was saved to this signal's history.
risk_rejected: The risk engine rejected this setup: {reason}
scan_ai_fallback: AI did not respond; the {symbol} analysis was written by the engine
scan_cancelled_partial: Scan stopped — {found} signals found so far are kept
scan_done: Scan complete: {found} signals from {scanned} symbols in {seconds}s
scan_empty: No directional signal found. The market is in wait mode right now.
scan_hint: The math engine checks symbols one by one with your confidence threshold and floats the best to the top. Pick "Top by turnover" with a count, or "Whole exchange" to scan every symbol the exchange lists. Results appear live while the scan runs. No AI tokens are spent.
scan_min_turnover_tip: Minimum 24-hour turnover in thousands of USDT. 0 means no limit.
scan_rows_capped: Showing the best {shown} of {total} results. Raise the confidence threshold to narrow the list.
scan_smart_filter_tip: Skips dead markets (zero turnover or price), stablecoin/stablecoin pairs and leveraged tokens (3L/3S/UP/DOWN), and scans the most active symbols first.
subtitle: Generate and review trading signals
wait_no_trade: Status is {direction}; no trade is suggested right now.
wait_note: WAIT is a valid decision. When timeframes conflict, staying out is safer than forcing a trade.
wait_result: {symbol}: WAIT — entry conditions are not met

share.copy_symbol_tip: Copy the symbol name (e.g. BTC/USDT) to the clipboard
share.copy_info_tip: Copy the full signal (direction, entry, stop, targets, leverage…) to paste or send elsewhere
share.table_hint: Tip: right-click a row to copy its symbol or full signal info (Ctrl+C copies the selected row's info).
share.share_tip: Send the signal to Telegram, WhatsApp, Rubika, Eitaa, Bale, X or email
share.copied_paste: Text copied — paste it in the chat ✓
share.subject: Trading signal

trade_open_failed: Could not open the trade: entry or stop-loss is invalid
trade_refused_stop: Trade not opened: live price ({price}) is already past the stop-loss
trade_refused_target: Trade not opened: live price ({price}) is already past TP1 — the entry is gone
trade_margin_capped: Size was capped to the available paper balance
